text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today, Rice Shower is in her signature
racewear
for an interview. She's currently
on standby.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Deep breaths, deep breaths... In... and
out...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: A little...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
But I got the questions beforehand and
was able
to practice my answers, so I'll
be okay!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
She's still speaking when the interviewer
runs over
toward us in a panic.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me, Rice Shower. I'm so sorry,
but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Y-yes?!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
The questions we sent you before were
actually
intended for a different
interview...

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
There was some kind of mix-up, and
they were
given to you by mistake.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
You have my sincerest apologies! I
understand
that you've prepared
answers for those
questions...

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
What should we do? Do we have to
cancel?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Even the interview staff look troubled.
I'm also
thinking about what we should
do, when...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...A-actually!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
You can... ask me whatever you want!
Even
questions I didn't prepare for are
okay!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: If I can answer, then I will.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
R-really? If you're sure, that would really
help us
out.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Brother...
choice_data_list: やらせてやってください
やらせてやってください

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Big Sister...

text_block_list.name: Photographer A
text_block_list.text:
Well, as long as you're both okay with
it... Thank
you.

text_block_list.name: Interviewer A
text_block_list.text:
Truly, thank you! Shall we get started
then?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Yes!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower answers the questions
confidently,
and the interview goes off
without a hitch.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...How did I do, Big Brother?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...How did I do, Big Sister?
choice_data_list_en: How do you feel about it yourself?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Hehe...
choice_data_list_en: How do you feel about it yourself?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I got so much courage from wearing
these clothes
during the interview. It was
just like when I'm
racing!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Yeah... But not just the clothes.
choice_data_list: 支えてもらえたんだな
支えてもらえたんだね
choice_data_list_en: They really supported you, didn't they?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
What's supported me the most... and
given me
the most courage...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is you, Big Brother.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Is you, Big Sister.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She cracks a small, happy smile.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I think that—well, just a little bit, but...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
I'm finally worthy of wearing these
clothes.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. It's embarrassing to say that about
myself.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...That's because you believed in me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...That's because you believed in me.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: So please, please, always believe in me.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
I nod reassuringly, and she smiles at me
joyfully.
